definitions.root: canonical nonterminal input CNF supplied to the frozen v3 engine
definitions.v_t: number of live semantic variables in the residual at any continuing frozen-engine state t

lemma_root_variable_ceiling.statement: For every nonempty nonterminal root with r0>=1, N>=2*r0+2 and therefore r0<=floor((N-2)/2).
proof: A nonempty root containing r0 distinct variables has at least one clause and at least r0 literal occurrences.
N=state_units(root)+r0 for this nontrivial case, so N>=2*r0+2.

lemma_live_count_monotonicity.statement: Every nonterminal continuing transition admitted by the frozen v3 engine satisfies v_{t+1}<=v_t; every successful root-free v3 macro-tail step satisfies v_{t+1}<=v_t-1.
cases: Unit propagation/restriction removes literals/variables and introduces none.
Ordinary exact existential elimination removes the pivot and introduces no fresh variable.
v2 B2 root-restoration macro introduces at most one fresh extension variable and is admitted atomically only together with elimination of one old live root pivot, so live count does not increase.
v3 tail introduces at most one fresh extension variable and atomically eliminates two distinct old pre-macro live pivots, so live count decreases by at least one.
2-SAT/GF2/bounded-resolution certificate lanes terminate with a verdict rather than produce a continuing enlarged residual.

theorem.name: FROZEN_REACHABLE_LIVE_VARIABLE_CEILING
theorem.statement: For every continuing state reachable from a legitimate nonterminal root under the frozen v3 engine, v_t<=r0<=floor((N-2)/2).
theorem.proof: Combine the root-variable ceiling with induction over the live-count-nonincreasing transition relation.

application.effect_on_claim: The witness remains a valid arbitrary-state grammar gap but is not a counterexample to reachable-state totality. Frozen v3 grammar must not be patched merely to cover this witness.

new_research_constraint.name: REACHABILITY_COMPATIBLE_ADVERSARY_CEILING
new_research_constraint.rule: Any future synthetic root-free stress state intended to challenge reachable-state totality at original N must satisfy live_variables<=floor((N-2)/2) before deeper reachability analysis is worth attempting.
new_research_constraint.stronger_requirement: Passing this necessary ceiling still does not establish reachability; exact forward provenance remains required for a true reachable counterexample.

next_exact_target: Regenerate balanced-pressure adversaries inside live_variables<=floor((N-2)/2), then distinguish local gaps from states with exact forward reachability certificates.
